summary: Phase 16 EPIC 2.3 Progress Claim (Termin) & Change Order testing completed. All backend RBAC, lifecycle, and guardrail tests passed. All frontend UI components, navigation, and role-based access controls verified successfully. AP integration confirmed working.

backend_issues.notes: One test failed on second run due to data mutation (CO/2026/0002 has negative delta causing contract < 0), which is expected behavior and validates the guardrail. All 18 core tests passed on first run.

Backend RBAC: progress_claims view allowed for finance/owner/PM/site, denied for sales (403)
Backend RBAC: progress_claims approve denied for site_engineer (403), allowed for finance/owner
Backend RBAC: change_orders view allowed for finance/owner/PM/site, denied for sales (403)
Backend RBAC: change_orders approve denied for site_engineer (403), allowed for finance/owner
Backend: Progress Claim GET returns seeded TRM/2026/0001 (40->60%, gross_est 60M)
Backend: Progress Claim verify sets status=verified and recomputes gross_est (50%, 30M)
Backend: Progress Claim approve creates AP bill (claimed 30M, net 28.5M) and advances SPK progress (40% -> 50%)
Backend: Progress Claim guardrail - cannot submit with progress_pct <= current (400)
Backend: Change Order GET returns seeded CO/2026/0001 (draft, +25M)
Backend: Change Order approve updates SPK contract_value (300M -> 325M)
Backend: Change Order guardrail - negative delta causing value < 0 rejected (400)
Backend: AP Integration - approved claim creates AP bill with correct vendor and amounts
Frontend: Login successful for PM, Finance, Owner, Site Engineer roles
Frontend: Navigation to Subcon page works
Frontend: Progress & Termin tab (data-testid='subcon-tab-claims') exists and loads
Frontend: Metrics cards display (Total Termin, Menunggu Proses, Disetujui, Retensi Ditahan)
Frontend: Claims table shows TRM/2026/0001 with status 'Disetujui', progress 40%->50%, value Rp 30M
Frontend: 'Ajukan Termin' button visible for PM role
Frontend: Submit Termin dialog opens with SPK selector and progress % input
Frontend: SPK tab navigation works
Frontend: SPK detail sheet opens showing contract details (SPK/2026/0001, CV Bangun Jaya, Rp 325M, 50% progress)
Frontend: Change Order section (data-testid='co-section') present in SPK detail
Frontend: 'Buat CO' button visible for PM role
Frontend: Create CO dialog opens with all form fields (title, delta, time extension)
Frontend: 3 Change Orders displayed in SPK detail (CO/2026/0003, CO/2026/0002 draft, CO/2026/0001 approved)
Frontend: CO 'Setujui' and 'Tolak' buttons visible for Owner role on draft COs
Frontend: Site engineer can view claims but approve button correctly hidden
Frontend Regression: Finance AP page (Hutang) still loads successfully
